body: Founder: 'when draining the queue we need a longer wait between.' promptoverseDefaultInterRequestDelay raised to 20s, overridable via PROMPTOVERSE_INTER_REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS. New test covers default + override + malformed-value fallback. Commit 93c9010.
title: Prompt-o-verse drain delay bumped 6s -> 20s, now configurable
